items.title: RayJ Dennis (G League assignment) is currently listed as questionable for tonight's game.
items.author: Brad Rowland
items.body_excerpt:
RayJ Dennis (G League assignment) is currently listed as questionable for tonight's game.

Dennis played 8 minutes in the win over Indiana when Flemings was suspended and Jalen was out.

McCollum played 32 minutes in that game and the other 8 PG minutes basically went to Dyson.

quote.author: Brad Rowland
quote.text:
The Hawks are currently 7.5-point road favorites in Chicago tonight... if you enjoy that sort of thing.

Kingston Flemings (lumbar spasm) is listed as questionable for Atlanta.

Norm Powell is questionable for the Bulls, with Caleb Wilson ruled out.

2nd NBA Cup group stage game for both teams.

items.author: Brad Rowland

With Kingston Flemings returning tonight, RayJ Dennis was assigned back to College Park.

Still TBD on Jalen Johnson.

items.title: RayJ Dennis getting some run now to open Q2.
items.author: Brad Rowland
items.body_excerpt:
RayJ Dennis getting some run now to open Q2.

First appearance by a Hawks two-way player this season.

items.title: Two-way point guard RayJ Dennis is also with the Hawks right now.
items.author: Brad Rowland
items.body_excerpt:
Two-way point guard RayJ Dennis is also with the Hawks right now.

One wonders if that might be potential suspension insurance on Flemings.

(but that is not a report from me, just a guess)

quote.author: Brad Rowland
quote.text:
Hawks injury report for Monday in Indiana:

Jalen Johnson (left ankle sprain) is questionable.

Jock Landale (left hip strain) is out.

Gueye (foot), Veesaar (knee) still out.

quote.author: Brad Rowland
quote.text:
First official Hawks injury report of the season ahead of Wednesday’s opener in Orlando:

Mouhamed Gueye (left foot fracture) is out.

Henri Veesaar (torn right ACL) is out.
